(def print-meta?
  (fn [opts obj]
  (and (boolean (or (pr-opts-dup opts)
                    (and (pr-opts-meta opts) (pr-opts-readably opts))))
       (implements? IMeta obj)
       (not (nil? (meta obj))))))
rationale: Expand defn to def/fn and follow Clojure's print-meta condition (#302): metadata prints under *print-dup*, or under *print-meta* when printing readably, so print and print-str omit it.
